title: Spike mitigation autotuner and eviction telemetry playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Post-incident follow-up for a dedicated-cluster capacity event where multiple tenants experienced transient evictions and degraded latencies during an unanticipated traffic spike. This ticket captures the root-cause analysis, proposed permanent mitigations (autotuning reservation shim + eviction telemetry), short-term runbook changes, and an implementation/rollout plan for a reservation autotuner and better eviction observability.
timeline:
- 2026-02-14 03:12 UTC: On-call alert - spike in eviction events in eu-west cluster
- 2026-02-14 03:15 UTC: Initial mitigation - temporary increase of soft-burst window and activation of emergency reserve for high-tier tenants
- 2026-02-14 04:02 UTC: Evictions subsided after 40m but latency remained elevated for some customers due to cache thrash
- 2026-02-15: Post-incident triage: kernel scheduling contention and under-provisioned tenant reservations found; burst policy allowed short surges but sequence-length distribution amplified KV cache pressure
- 2026-02-18: Decision to pursue two parallel tracks: (A) implement eviction telemetry + adaptive soft-shim reservations; (B) prototype reservation autotuner that uses historical spike patterns to suggest reservation deltas
root_cause: A confluence of factors: noisy-tenant burst hitting during an uncommon long-sequence batch window, reservation targets set conservatively low for cost reasons, and the burst policy's short TTL failing to give KV caches time to stabilize. The scheduler rapidly reclaimed memory from lower-priority tenants leading to eviction storms; existing instrumentation lacked fine-grained per-tenant eviction histograms and pre/post KV hit-rate deltas which slowed diagnosis.
impact_summary:
- Customer-facing: transient request failures for ~8 customers, increased 95th-percentile latency by ~2.3x for affected tenants for ~45 minutes.
- Operational: on-call runbook invoked; manual capacity interventions required.
- Financial: short-term increased infra spend due to emergency reserve allocation.
Estimated customers impacted: medium (8 commercial tenants), potential upstream ripple for shared pipelines.
mitigation_summary:
Short-term: extend soft-burst TTL to 90s for suspect pools during high variance windows, pre-warm KV caches for high-replay tenants, and add an automated eviction alert with per-tenant rate thresholds.
Long-term: implement a reservation autotuner that computes per-tenant delta reservations from historical spike telemetry, and add eviction telemetry (per-tenant eviction histogram, KV hit-rate before/after eviction, sequence-length windowing) to Console dashboards and incident runbooks.
action_items: A1: Add per-tenant eviction histogram and KV-hit delta telemetry to runtime tracing (owner: Marco) - estimate 3 pts - due 2026-03-05
A2: Prototype reservation autotuner service: offline simulation harness + online proposer (read-only initially) (owner: Priya Sengupta) - estimate 5 pts - due 2026-03-18
A3: Implement 'soft-shim' reservations that can be temporarily inflated by autotuner proposals with guardrails and cooldown (owner: Kernel Team) - estimate 5 pts - due 2026-04-01
A4: Update Dedicated runbook: add step to raise soft-burst TTL and enable KV prewarm for flagged tenants (owner: Oncall) - estimate 1 pt - due 2026-02-25
A5: Create synthetic tenant rebalance simulator to validate autotuner proposals under controlled stress (owner: SRE) - estimate 3 pts - due 2026-03-10
A6: Add graceful degradation policy to scheduler: soft-preempt first, then evict, with per-tenant backoff (owner: Scheduler) - estimate 4 pts - due 2026-04-08
A7: Dashboard and alerting: add Console chart 'tenant eviction bursts' and set P95 threshold alert (owner: Observability) - estimate 2 pts - due 2026-03-01
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (telemetry + runbook) - deploy eviction histograms & KV deltas to staging, validate with synthetic workload, add dashboard and alerting, update runbook.
Phase 2 (autotuner read-only) - run autotuner in proposal mode for 2 weeks, compare proposals to historical incidents; no automatic changes.
Phase 3 (autotuner pilot) - enable automated soft-shim adjustments for 10 low-risk tenants with 5% cap and 15-minute cooldown. Monitor eviction rate, KV-hit delta, and latency.
Phase 4 (scaled rollout) - if pilot meets success criteria (evictions reduced by >=80% for spikes without increased cost beyond threshold), expand to high-tier pools with manual approvals.
Rollback: immediate revert of soft-shim with a control-plane toggle; autotuner proposals always reversible and must pass safety checks before enactment.
